headline: Wintermute Warns Bitcoin Risks Drop Toward $50,000s on Rising Fed Rate Hike Bets
summary: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000 range after falling below its 200-week moving average, pressured by spot ETF outflows, weak demand, and building bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes.
why: Wintermute is one of the largest digital asset algorithmic market makers, and institutional trading flows heavily reflect macroeconomic and rate policy expectations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Loss of technical support at the 200-week average combined with ETF outflows and rate hike bets pressures crypto liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
